name: Yowami o Nigitte Hitozuma to Sono Musume o Pakottemita.
original_name: 弱みを握って人妻とその娘をパコってみた。
source:
* Vulnerable x Wife x Hot Humping *
Mr. Hayashida of Hayashida Supermarket wanted to have sex with his employee, Aki.
He often lingered and watched the married woman after her shift was over, and one day learned something secret.
That secret was the morsel he needed to feed his own hunger!
As his desire grew, so did the scope of his exploit, which turned to Aki's daughter...
